# Layer search


You can now search your layers by name, right from the layers panel: great for finding the one element you need to tweak in large, complex files, jumping straight to a nested layer without expanding every group, or navigating a file someone else built.


Here's how to use layer search:


1. In your Jitter file, click the 🔍 icon at the top of the layers panel on the left.
2. Type all or part of a layer's name.
3. Click a result to select that layer on the canvas.


This small change is a big time saver, especially in your busiest files.


## Other improvements


- Better multilingual text: Arabic, Hebrew, and mixed-direction text now render more accurately, with style-matched fallback fonts for missing scripts.
- Smoother media swaps in components: Replacing an image or video in a component now updates all of its instances.
